assignments.mission: Choose A/B/C strictly from given facts. Balance capacity limits, lower-pay fixed-slot contract, standardized shorter sessions, brand promise of unhurried care, uneven site utilization, seasonality, 1+ year hiring lag, and two leases expiring. Deliver: decision with core reason, strongest counterargument, flip conditions, and 3-year internal mechanisms (ops/scheduling, clinical QA/standards, pricing/mix, throughput governance).

reason: Single strategic trade-off decision with operational and brand risk implications fits a business strategist. No external research or creative work is needed; all inputs are provided. One specialist can produce a high-quality, actionable recommendation.
